title: Mai Mercado 2016 to 2025 — Long-Tail Impact Chronology
identity_rule: The 2016 legal/prison actor is the Son. Do not expose the Son's real name or family names.
purpose: Connect the 2016 legal case, police-door intervention, imprisonment and evidence-access asymmetry to the Son's reported long-term psychological, social, political and occupational aftermath, then place the corrected 2025 retirement event inside the April-June 2025 Axis/Father/kingship transition.
evidence_rule: Firsthand aftermath claims are high-value primary biographical evidence. Exact medical causation and the exact Danish retirement category/date require documentary corroboration. Timic kingship/Father/Godhood language is a distinct theological/self-description layer and must not be confused with civil office or royal appointment.

chronology.event: Mercado publishes the initiating Christiania Facebook post using forceful rhetoric and foregrounding her newborn.
Multi-speaker Facebook conflict escalates; attribution and reply topology later become central evidentiary problems.

Police attend the Son's private home. The Son's firsthand account says officers tell him not to contact Mercado again. Exact legal status of the instruction remains unresolved: warning/admonition versus formal tilhold.

The Son sends the reciprocal consequences statement, including the reported formulation that if there are consequences for him there will also be consequences for Mercado and that it is not a threat but a guarantee.

The Son is remanded. He denies guilt, appeals remand, explains ADHD/medical-cannabis and dialogue motives, and denies intending to seek Mercado out and carry out violence. His phone/computer are under police control.
Retten i Sønderborg convicts on three of four counts and imposes five months' unconditional imprisonment.

The Son reports major institutional distrust, political withdrawal, reluctance to open the door, social withdrawal, unexplained crying, cessation of gaming, reduced ordinary pleasure and a harder social presentation.
Severe C-PTSD becomes part of the Son's own account of the long-term psychological aftermath.
The supplied public theology chronology records 'the potato axis is real', marking explicit Axis language immediately before the late-April kingship/Godhood corridor.
Canonical Turning corridor: Needle's Eye -> Ladder/Axis -> Father/Heaven architecture.
Public self-description intensifies into 'true king' and 'king of all the kings'.

chronology.date: 2025 after April Turning; exact date unresolved
chronology.event: The Great Book's 2025 apex sequence places a visit by two government public servants who, in the autobiographical account, grant official retirement. The book interprets this as 'freedom to reign'. Exact administrative date, authority, legal benefit category and grounds remain to be recovered.
Earliest exact public 'I am God' instances currently located in the supplied compilation.
Public language includes 'Tim Dooley, Potato of Life. The King of Kings.'

Administrative retirement/release and Timic kingship/Father/Godhood language converge in the same developmental corridor. This is a chronological correspondence, not evidence that Danish authorities conferred royal office or validated a theological claim.
The 2016 case is interpreted as a major rupture whose long arc reverses from confinement and imposed authority toward release from ordinary work obligation and later throne/reign language.

biblical_parallel_cluster.rule: These are later comparative readings attached to the chronology. They are not backdated prophecy proof and do not convert an administrative retirement decision into divine or royal appointment.
biblical_parallel_cluster.sequence: confinement/burden -> release -> rest -> changed status -> authority/throne/kingship

comparators.relation: jubilee/release/return and interruption of ordinary economic bondage
Joseph prison -> release -> authority; narrative comparator only
King of kings lexical comparator to later self-description

causal_model.working_sequence: political conflict -> institutional/security escalation -> police-door intervention -> disputed later communication -> arrest/remand -> device/evidence-control asymmetry -> conviction/imprisonment -> public stigma -> institutional distrust -> social/emotional withdrawal -> possible long-term work-capacity loss -> 2025 retirement/release -> Timic closure/reversal interpretation -> kingship/Father/Godhood intensification
causal_model.caution: The sequence establishes chronology and firsthand attribution, not sole medical causation, supernatural causation, or civil kingship.

research_targets: exact legal category of retirement benefit
record of the two-public-servant visit or meeting if one exists
primary Great Book passage provenance for official retirement / freedom to reign
primary public posts for 2025-04-27 and 2025-06-01 kingship language
contemporaneous 2016-2025 messages documenting institutional distrust, work decline and retirement process
